does: Pours boiling water over a ready-made food, to wash off the surface oil or the smell from the making before it goes into a pot or a dish. The food is not cooked, only scalded.

intro.what: This preparation scalds a ready-made food by pouring boiling water across its surface.
intro.why: It teaches you to remove surface oil without immersing the food in a prolonged boil.

how: Put the food in a colander or a heatproof bowl.
Pour boiling water over it, slowly and evenly, so that every surface is touched.
Drain it, and press it gently with a clean cloth or paper if it will be fried or stuffed.
Cut or use it right away.

cues.text: The surface oil, which floated as a sheen, has run off with the water.
The smell of oil or of the making is gone.

mistakes.mistake: Boiling the food in the pot, which makes it soft and waterlogged.
Skipping the scald before simmering, so that the broth turns greasy.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of this pouring step?
choices: To hydrate the food deeply before further cooking.
To soften the whole piece before it reaches the pan.
To carry off surface oil before further preparation.
quiz.because: A brief surface rinse can remove oil without the prolonged immersion that waterlogs the food.

quiz.question: How should the water contact the food?
choices: Pour slowly and evenly across all surfaces.
Leave the food submerged at a rolling boil.
Wet only the centre and leave the edges untouched.
quiz.because: Even pouring treats the surface while keeping this a scalding step rather than a long boil.

quiz.question: Which visible change suggests surface oil has been washed away?
choices: The sheen remains on the surface after draining.
The oily sheen runs off with the water.
Water gathers without carrying a visible sheen.
quiz.because: Oil carried away in the runoff leaves less free oil on the surface.

quiz.question: The food became soft and waterlogged. What would you change next time?
choices: Boil it longer to even out the texture.
Leave it soaking after the pour.
Pour the water over and drain instead of boiling it in the pot.
quiz.because: Limiting water contact preserves structure while removing the surface residue.
